comments.why: High quality content across varied projects from the channel
comments.text: The sequel to this video: [VIDEO] The Thought Emporium makes really high quality content. He does a lot of things, most recently covering things in metal, but in the past they have made videos on gene editing, growing opals, and making holograms. It’s a lot of different topics, all presented very well.

comments.author: c0nducktr
comments.story: Receiving NOAA Weather Satellite Images with $10 USB SDR Device (2014) [video]
comments.why: Inspired a hobby of receiving GOES satellite imagery
comments.text: I'm in the process of setting up an antenna for receiving data from the GOES-15 weather satellite. I'm just starting out but got inspired after watching this video (no affiliation with the channel). [VIDEO] People have been able to get some stunning pictures of the earth from those satellites. Examples: [LINK] [LINK] [LINK] If you're interested, check out r/rtlsdr, which is where I first was introduced to the hobby. It's full of helpful people.
